ns2:section.sectionText: MCB 253 section I is the MCB Honors section with enrollment also open to James Scholars. Concurrent registration in MCB 290 EAB is required. All other interested students should contact Shawna Naidu at shawna@uiuc.edu for information and approval. Laboratories begin on Monday, August 27, 2007. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7-9 PM on 23 October and 4 December 2007. Enrollment in this course is restricted to sophmores, juniors and seniors. To be considered for an override as a freshman, please contact Deb Bielser at bielser@life.uiuc.edu.
